verse: God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of self-control. (2 Tim 1:7)
There is no fear in love. Instead, perfect love casts out fear, for fear pertains to punishment. And whoever fears is not perfected in love. (1 Jn 4:18)
You have forgotten the Lord, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You fear continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor. (Is 51:13)
Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but are not able to kill the soul. But instead fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell. (Matt 10:28)
Be strong and courageous. Do not fear, and do not be dismayed. For the Lord your God is with you wherever you go. (Josh 1:9)
Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, and I will help you, and my victorious right hand will uphold you. (Is 41:10)

When you go out to battle against your enemies, and you see horsemen and chariots, and that the multitude of your adversary’s army is greater than your own, you shall not fear them. For the Lord your God, who led you away from the land of Egypt, is with you. (Deut 20:1)

Thus said the Lord to me, while his strong hand was upon me, and warned me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying: Do not call conspiracy all that this people calls conspiracy, and do not fear what they fear, or be in dread. But the Lord of hosts, him you shall honor as holy; let him be your fear and let him be your dread. (Is 8:11-13)
I sought the Lord, and he heeded me, and he delivered me from all my fears. (Ps 34:4)

But as for you, do not fear, my servant Jacob, nor be dismayed, O Israel; for I am going to save you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and there shall be none to terrify him. (Jer 46:27)
In God, whose Word I praise. In God, I have put my trust. I shall not be afraid. What flesh can do to me? (Ps 56:4)
Fear is nothing but giving up the help that come from reason. And when inner hope is weak, people prefer to ignore the cause that brings the torment. (Wis 17:12-13)
Whoever fears man will quickly fall. Whoever trusts in the Lord shall be safe. (Pro 29:25)
The Lord is on my side. I will not fear what man can do to me. (Ps 118:6)

Be strong and of courage. Do not be afraid. Neither should you dread the king of the Assyrians and the entire multitude that is with him. For many more are with us than with him. For with him is an arm of flesh; with us is the Lord our God, who is our helper, and who fights for us. (2 Chron 32:7-8)
Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident. (Ps 27:3)
It is I, I myself, who will comfort you. Why then would you be afraid of a mere mortal who must die, a human who will wither like the grass? (Is 51:12)
You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day, nor the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor the destruction that strikes at noonday. (Ps 91:5-6)
I lie down and sleep; I awoke, for the Lord sustains me. I am not afraid of ten thousands of people who have taken position against me on every side. (Ps 3:5-6)

You have forgotten the Lord, your Maker, who extended the heavens, and who founded the earth. You have been in constant fear, all day long, at the face of his fury, of the one who oppressed you and who had prepared to destroy you. (Is 51:13)

Our God is our refuge and strength, a helper in the tribulations that have greatly overwhelmed us. Because of this, we will not be afraid when the earth will be turbulent and the mountains will be transferred into the heart of the sea. Though they thundered, and the waters were stirred up among them, though the mountains have been disturbed by his strength. (Ps 46:1-3)
Do not be afraid, and do not dread or have fear of them. For the Lord your God himself goes with you, and he will neither fail you nor abandon you. (Deut 31:6)
Peace I leave with you; my Peace I give to you. Not as the world gives, do I give to you. Do not let your heart be troubled and let it not fear. (Jn 14:27)

Strengthen the weak hands and make firm the feeble knees! Say to those who are fearful of heart: “Take courage and fear not! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. God himself will come to save you.” (Is 35:3-4)
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me. (Ps 23:4)
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid? (Ps 27:1)
Then David said to his son Solomon, “Be strong and courageous, and act; do not fear nor be dismayed, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. (1 Chron 28:20)
Whenever I am afraid, I put my trust in you. (Ps 56:3)
Thus says the Lord who created you, O Jacob, and who formed you, O Israel: Do not be afraid. For I have redeemed you, and I have called you by your name. You are mine. (Is 43:1)
You will be established in righteousness. You shall be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid. And from terror, for it will not come near you. (Is 54:14)
Do not fear unexpected terror, nor the destruction of the impious when it comes. For the Lord will be at your side, and he will guard your feet, so that you may not be trapped. (Pro 3:25-26)
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and the rivers will not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you will not be burned, and the flames will not scorch you. (Is 43:2)
Behold God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid, for the Lord God is my strength and my might; and he has become my salvation. (Is 12:2)
You have not received a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received the Spirit of adoption by whom we call out, “Abba, Father!” (Rom 8:15)
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you, Lord, make me dwell in safety. (Ps 4:8)

While they were talking about these things, Jesus stood in their midst, And he said to them: “Peace be with you. It is I. Do not be afraid.” They were very disturbed and terrified, supposing that they saw a ghost. And he said to them: “Why are you frightened, and why do doubts rise up in your hearts? (Luk 24:36-38)
Listen to me, you who know what is right, you who have my laws in your hearts; do not fear the reproach of others, and do not be dismayed of their revilings. (Is 51:7)
Fear not, my servant Jacob, says the Lord, nor be dismayed, O Israel; for behold, I will save you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. (Jer 30:10)

I will deliver you on that day, says the Lord, and you shall not be handed over to those whom you dread. For I will surely save you, and you shall not fall by the sword; but you shall have your life as a prize of war, because you have trusted in me. (Jer 39:17-18)

Do not be afraid of what they fear, and do not be intimidated, but in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be ready to defend to anyone who asks you to give an account for the hope that is in you. (1 Pet 3:14-15)
The Lord has removed the judgments against you; he has turned away your enemies. The king of Israel, the Lord, is among you; you shall fear disaster no more. (Zeph 3:15)
Fear not, my servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you. I will make a full end of all the nations among which I have exiled you, but I will not destroy you! (Jer 46:28)

I called on your name, O Lord, out of the lowest pit; you heard my cry, “Do not close your ear to my cry for help, but bring me relief!” You drew near when I called to you; you said, “Do not be afraid!” (Lam 3:55-57)
Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands be slack. The Lord, your God, is in your midst, a warrior who saves. (Zeph 3:16-17)
Do not be afraid, only believe. (Mrk 5:36)

I am certain that neither death, nor life, nor Angels, nor Principalities, nor Powers, nor the present things, nor the future things, nor strength, nor the heights, nor the depths, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. (Rom 8:38-39)

The disciples went and woke him up, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!” And Jesus said to them, “Why are you fearful, you of little faith?” Then he rose and rebuked the wind and the sea; and there was a great calm. (Matt 8:25-26)
God has said, “I will never leave you or abandon you.” So, we say with confidence, “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?” (Heb 13:5-6)
When they had prayed, the place where they were gathered together was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and continued to proclaim the word of God with boldness. (Acts 4:31)
The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold like a lion. (Pro 28:1)
